top_signals.title: Trump Says US Controls the Strait of Hormuz, But Talks Continue
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump claimed the US had “total control over the Hormuz Strait,” saying “We own it” and that Iran's actions will be met with force. Talks appear to be deadlocked as each side hardens their stance. Oil prices have been climbing as traders remain uncertain about the prospects of a deal. Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ukraine Halts Oil Tanker Attacks on JD Vance Request
top_signals.summary: The Ukrainian forces have reportedly suspended drone attacks on oil tankers at the port of Novorossiysk following a request by U.S. Vice-President JD Vance, the Financial Times wrote today, citing unnamed Ukrainian officials. The request was prompted by concern that the drone attacks that shut down the Caspian Pipeline Consortium twice over the last two months were additionally destabilizing an already destabilized global oil market. top_signals.title: China Revives Free-Trade-Zone Bond Market After Crackdown
top_signals.summary: The Shanghai free-trade zone’s bond market had its first pricing by a nonfinancial firm since Chinese authorities clamped down on excessive borrowing by local governments in late 2023.
